## 0.0 Introduction and Set-up

In this script I will assess what is associated with variation on the X and Y chromosome beta-values with PCA in both 450K and SPAH datasets.

NOTE: When I first wrote these scripts I called the 450K Dataset the 'Discovery Cohort' and the SPAH Dataset the 'Validation Cohort'. You may still see objects named this way.

```{r packages, warning=F, message=F}

library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(plomics)
library(rstatix)
library(ggpubr)
library(irlba)
library(tableone)
library(cowplot)

set.seed(4815)

```

## 2.0 Load Data

```{r data}

#450K dataset
disc_pDat <- readRDS(here::here("02_Outputs/01_450K_Proc/pDat_filt.RDS"))
dim(disc_pDat) #354 samples

## Remove samples with chromosome abnormalities
disc_pDat <- disc_pDat %>% filter(!Sample_ID %in% c("GSM2589548","GSM2674422"))
dim(disc_pDat) #352

#SPAH dataset
val_pDat <- readRDS(here::here("02_Outputs/02_SPAH_Proc/val_cohort_metadata.RDS"))
val_pDat <- val_pDat %>% filter(!is.na(PE_GA_state))
dim(val_pDat) #491 samples

```

### 2.1 Demographics

```{r table-one}

disc_pDat <- disc_pDat %>%
  mutate(GA_harmonized = ifelse(is.na(GA),GA_RPC, GA))%>%
  mutate(Condition_new = case_when(
           Condition =="EOPE" ~ "EOPE",
           Condition =="LOPE" ~ "LOPE",
           Condition =="PE" & GA_harmonized<34 ~ "EOPE",
           Condition =="PE" & GA_harmonized>=34 ~ "LOPE",
           GA_harmonized<37 ~ "nPTB",
           GA_harmonized>=37 ~ "nTB")) 
table(disc_pDat$Condition, disc_pDat$Condition_new)
table(disc_pDat$Condition_new)

table(val_pDat$PE_GA_state)

#combined metadata for the datasets
disc_pDat_select <- disc_pDat %>% 
  dplyr::select(Sample_ID, DNAme_Sex, PE, GA_harmonized, Prob_African, Prob_Asian, 
                Prob_Caucasian, nRBC, Hofbauer, Endothelial, 
                Stromal, Syncytiotrophoblast, Trophoblasts, CTB_STB, EOPE, PE_Status, Condition_new) %>%
  dplyr::rename(rgset_colnames = Sample_ID,
                Prob_European = Prob_Caucasian,
                GA= GA_harmonized) %>%
  mutate(Dataset = "450K")

val_pDat_select <- val_pDat %>%
  dplyr::select(rgset_colnames, Sex_Predic, pcr_pre_eclampsia, ga_continuous, Prob_African, Prob_Asian, Prob_European, nRBC, Hofbauer, Endothelial, 
                Stromal, Syncytiotrophoblast, Trophoblasts, CTB_STB,
                EOPE, PE_Status, PE_GA_state) %>%
  dplyr::rename(DNAme_Sex = Sex_Predic,
                Condition_new = PE_GA_state,
                PE = pcr_pre_eclampsia,
                GA = ga_continuous) %>%
  mutate(Dataset = "SPAH")

all.equal(colnames(disc_pDat_select), colnames(val_pDat_select))

all_pDat <- disc_pDat_select %>%
  rbind(val_pDat_select) %>%
  mutate(Dataset = factor(Dataset, levels=c("450K","SPAH")))
dim(all_pDat) #843

#Create a TableOne object
CreateTableOne (vars = c("DNAme_Sex", "EOPE", "Condition_new", "PE_Status", "GA"), data = all_pDat, factorVars = "DNAme_Sex", strata = "Dataset")

disc_tb1 <- CreateTableOne (vars = c("EOPE","PE_Status", "Condition_new","GA"),
                data = disc_pDat_select, strata = "DNAme_Sex")
print(disc_tb1, nonnormal="EOPE")

val_tb1 <- CreateTableOne (vars = c("EOPE","PE_Status", "Condition_new", "GA"),
                data = val_pDat_select, strata = "DNAme_Sex")
print(val_tb1, nonnormal="EOPE")

all_pDat %>%
  group_by(Dataset) %>%
  summarise_at(vars(EOPE), list(MEAN = mean, SD = sd, RANGE = range))

disc_pDat_select %>%
  group_by(Condition_new, DNAme_Sex) %>%
  summarise_at(vars(GA), list(mean = mean, sd = sd))


```

## 3.0 PCA

```{r probe-info}

#load the EPIC probe information
probeInfo <- readRDS("//fs/teams/RobinsonLab/Hannah/05_Projects/SPAH/E. Sex and Environment Project [abandon]/02_Outputs/02_Variability/hg38_b5_EPIC_probeinfo.rds")
probeInfo <- probeInfo %>% mutate(Start_hg38 = as.numeric(Start_hg38))

chrXprobes_EPIC <- probeInfo %>% filter(chr == "chrX")
chrYprobes_EPIC <- probeInfo %>% filter(chr == "chrY")
remove(probeInfo)

probeInfo_450k <- as.data.frame(cbind(
  IlluminaHumanMethylation450kanno.ilmn12.hg19::Locations, 
  IlluminaHumanMethylation450kanno.ilmn12.hg19::Other, 
  IlluminaHumanMethylation450kanno.ilmn12.hg19::Manifest))
probeInfo_450k$probeID <-rownames(probeInfo_450k)

chrXprobes_450k <- probeInfo_450k %>% filter (chr == "chrX") 
chrYprobes_450k <- probeInfo_450k %>% filter (chr == "chrY") 
remove(probeInfo_450k)

```

### 3.1 Function

```{r pca-function-setup}

principle_component_analysis <- function(pc_obj,cov, label){
  
  pc_matrix <- pc_obj$x #extract PC scores
  
  pc_pval <- lmmatrix(dep = pc_matrix[,1:10], ind = cov, metric = 'Pvalue') %>% as.data.frame
  pc_rsq <- lmmatrix(dep = pc_matrix[,1:10], ind = cov, metric = 'Rsquared') %>% as.data.frame
  
  pval_plot <- pc_pval %>% 
    # add variables from previous data 
    mutate(variable = rownames(.)) %>%
    # melt
    pivot_longer(c(-variable), names_to = "PC", values_to = "p.value" ) %>% 
    # give names to PCs
    mutate( PC = factor(PC, levels = colnames(pc_pval))) %>% as_tibble() %>%
    mutate( variable = factor(variable, levels = rev(colnames(cov)))) %>%
    mutate(p.adj = p.adjust(p.value, method = "fdr")) 
  
  #add a column to pval_plot that categorizes the p-values into ranges
  pval_plot <- pval_plot %>% mutate(p.val = case_when(
    p.adj <= 0.001 ~ "< 0.001",
    p.adj > 0.001 & p.adj <=0.01 ~ "< 0.01",
    p.adj > 0.01 & p.adj <=0.05 ~ "< 0.05",
    p.adj > 0.05 ~ "> 0.05"))
  
  rsq_plot <- pc_rsq %>%  
    # add variables from previous data 
    mutate(variable = rownames(.)) %>%
    # melt
    pivot_longer(c(-variable), names_to = "PC", values_to = "R.Squared" ) %>% 
    # give names to PCs
    mutate( PC = factor(PC, levels = colnames(pc_rsq))) %>% as_tibble()%>%
    mutate( variable = factor(variable, levels = rev(colnames(cov))))
  
  #add a column to rsq_plot that categorizes the rsquared values into ranges
  rsq_plot <- rsq_plot %>% mutate(R.Sq = case_when(
    R.Squared >= 0.8 ~ "> 0.8",
    R.Squared >= 0.6 & R.Squared < 0.8 ~ "> 0.6",
    R.Squared >= 0.4 & R.Squared < 0.6 ~ "> 0.4",
    R.Squared >= 0.2 & R.Squared < 0.4 ~ "> 0.2",
    R.Squared >= 0 & R.Squared < 0.2 ~ "< 0.2"))
  
  pca_plot<- pval_plot %>% left_join (rsq_plot) #by variable and PC
  
  #version with color
  pca_plot_trunc_col <- pca_plot %>%
    filter(PC %in% c("PC1","PC2","PC3","PC4"))%>%
    ggplot(aes(x=PC, y=variable, fill=ifelse(p.adj<0.05,R.Squared,NA))) +
    geom_tile(color = "grey",
              lwd = 0.5,
              linetype = 1)+
    # geom_tile(aes(color=factor(p.adj < 0.05), 
    #               size=factor(p.adj < 0.05)), alpha=0) +   
    scale_fill_gradientn(colours = c("white","#F4A582", "#820d1b"),
                         values = c(0,0.1,0.2,0.3,0.5,1), limits=c(0,1), na.value="grey88")+
    theme_bw()+
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust=0.5, size = 14, face ="bold"),
      axis.title = element_text(size=14),
      axis.text = element_text(size=12),
      legend.title = element_text(size=12),
      legend.text = element_text(size=10))+
scale_x_discrete(expand = c(0, 0), labels=1:4) +
  scale_y_discrete(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(fill = bquote(R ^2), y="", title=label)

#proportion of variance
prop_var <- t(summary(pc_obj)$importance) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column(., var="PC") %>%
  .[c(1:4),]
colnames(prop_var) <- make.names(colnames(prop_var))  #make.names fixes syntax errors like  space in names
prop_var$PC <- gsub("PC","",prop_var$PC)
prop_var$PC <- factor(prop_var$PC,levels = c(1:4))

prop_var_plot <- prop_var %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = PC, y = 100*Proportion.of.Variance)) +
  geom_bar(stat = 'identity')  + 
  labs(y = '% Variance') +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_y_continuous(n.breaks=4)


full_grid <- plot_grid(pca_plot_trunc_col,prop_var_plot, nrow = 2, rel_heights = c(1,0.3))
return(full_grid)
}

```

### 3.2 Discovery Cohort

```{r pca-disc}

disc_betas <- readRDS(here::here("02_Outputs/01_450K_Proc/betas_adjdas_filt.RDS"))
dim(disc_betas) #x354

disc_pDat_select <- disc_pDat_select %>%
  left_join((disc_pDat %>% dplyr::select(GEO_Dataset,Sample_ID)),
            by=c("rgset_colnames" ="Sample_ID"))

disc_pDat_select_xx <- disc_pDat_select %>% filter(DNAme_Sex == "XX")
disc_pDat_select_xy <- disc_pDat_select %>% filter(DNAme_Sex == "XY")

#select the X and Y chromosomes
disc_betas_xx <- disc_betas[rownames(disc_betas) %in% chrXprobes_450k$probeID,
                            disc_pDat_select_xx$rgset_colnames]
dim(disc_betas_xx) #9210 x 169
disc_betas_xy <- disc_betas[rownames(disc_betas) %in% chrXprobes_450k$probeID,
                            disc_pDat_select_xy$rgset_colnames]
dim(disc_betas_xy) #9210 x 183
disc_betas_y <- disc_betas[rownames(disc_betas) %in% chrYprobes_450k$probeID,
                           disc_pDat_select_xy$rgset_colnames]
dim(disc_betas_y) #226 x 183

#perform pca
pc_obj_disc_xx <- prcomp_irlba(t(disc_betas_xx), n=10)
pc_obj_disc_xy <- prcomp_irlba(t(disc_betas_xy), n=10) 
pc_obj_disc_y <- prcomp_irlba(t(disc_betas_y), n=10) 

#pca plots
#remove columns that we don't want as part of the pca plots
disc_cov_xx <- disc_pDat_select_xx %>%
  dplyr::select("GEO_Dataset","PE","GA", num_vars) %>%
  dplyr::rename("GEO Dataset" = GEO_Dataset,
                "eoPRED" = EOPE,
                "Cytotrophoblast" = Trophoblasts,
                "P(European)" = Prob_European,
                "P(African)" = Prob_African,
                "P(Asian)" = Prob_Asian)
disc_cov_xy <- disc_pDat_select_xy %>%
  dplyr::select("GEO_Dataset","PE","GA", num_vars) %>%
  dplyr::rename("GEO Dataset" = GEO_Dataset,
                "eoPRED" = EOPE,
                "Cytotrophoblast" = Trophoblasts,
                "P(European)" = Prob_European,
                "P(African)" = Prob_African,
                "P(Asian)" = Prob_Asian)

pca_plots_disc_xx <- principle_component_analysis(pc_obj_disc_xx, disc_cov_xx, "X chr (XX)")
pca_plots_disc_xy <- principle_component_analysis(pc_obj_disc_xy, disc_cov_xy, "X chr (XY)")
pca_plots_disc_y <- principle_component_analysis(pc_obj_disc_y, disc_cov_xy, "Y chr (XY)")

pca_plots_disc_xx
pca_plots_disc_xy
pca_plots_disc_y

title_disc <- ggdraw() + 
  draw_label("450K Dataset",
             fontface = 'bold',
             size=14,
             hjust = 0.5) 

pca_plots_disc <- plot_grid(NULL, NULL, NULL,
                            pca_plots_disc_xx + theme(legend.position="none"),
                            pca_plots_disc_xy+ theme(legend.position="none"),
                            pca_plots_disc_y, nrow=2, ncol=3,
                            rel_heights = c(0.075,1))
pca_plots_disc

ggsave(filename=here::here("02_Outputs/03_PCA/450K_PCA_plots.png"),plot=pca_plots_disc, device="png",height=7.5,width=12)

```
